senses.gloss: m. (preced.) סְכֵי שמש looking to the sun, euphem. for squinting, cross-eyed.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:3">Tosef. Bekh. V, 3</cite>, expl. <he>שרואה את החדר וכ׳</he> who takes in the room and the ceiling in one glance; <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:3">Bekh. VII, 3</cite>, changed by R. Jose.
ib. 44ᵃ: סני שמש one who hates the sun, blinkard
